title: Ankara 140 GHz specular reflection data-readiness audit

dataset.name: Ankara Open Planning Dataset
dataset.confidence: Static planning dataset with synthetic demand enrichment; not an operator inventory.
dataset.loader_note: The current BuildingFootprint loader retains outer rings only. Holes are not represented as exterior facade candidates; the 936651 segment count is therefore a loader-visible outer-edge count, not a complete physical facade inventory.

height_evidence.source: Concept 4F.1 loader semantics and current Ankara audit
height_evidence.fallback_policy: The display-only default 9 m three-storey fallback is not accepted as facade vertical evidence.
height_evidence.terrain_anchor: No base elevation/terrain layer is available; trusted roof-height tags are relative planning evidence, not a surveyed wall base/top pair.

material_thickness_roughness_evidence.interpretation: No Ankara facade can currently select a calibrated P.2040 material row, thickness, roughness, or slab/interface mode from dataset evidence. The audit must not infer them from building type, density, or generic concrete assumptions.

terrain_and_morphology.allowed_future_assumption: flat_ground_relative_datum only when explicitly declared; never label as measured terrain

geometry_only_candidate_sample.candidate_method: For each path and loader-visible outer edge in a spatially expanded bounding box, reflect the Tx point across the edge's locally oriented vertical plane and count finite-segment image intersections. This is an audit-only geometry count; it does not test visibility, roughness, material, antenna, atmospheric, terrain, or coherent fields.
geometry_only_candidate_sample.interpretation: These are mathematical readiness/sample intersections only. They are not viable reflected links, coverage results, or evidence that any surface is specular.

readiness_conclusion.reason: The pack is sufficient to demonstrate 2D edge/image geometry, but it lacks the material, thickness, roughness, surveyed facade-plane, terrain/base-elevation and visibility evidence required for an honest automatic 140 GHz reflected-path result.
readiness_conclusion.safe_statement: A future 4I.5B reference can accept explicitly supplied facade/material geometry and return qualified isolated path results; the current Ankara pack cannot populate those inputs automatically.
